documents.title: Hainanese chicken rice recipe
documents.content: Hainanese chicken rice recipe. Poach chicken with ginger and spring onion for 35 minutes. Cook rice in chicken stock with garlic and pandan leaves. Serve with cucumber and chilli sauce.

documents.title: Roasted chicken rice recipe
documents.content: Roasted chicken rice recipe. Marinate chicken with soy sauce and five spice, then roast at 190 C for 45 minutes. Serve with rice cooked in chicken stock.

documents.title: Eggplant sambal recipe
documents.content: Eggplant sambal recipe. Slice eggplant and fry until soft. Pound dried chilli, shallots and belacan, then cook the sambal and toss with the eggplant.

documents.title: Nasi lemak recipe
documents.content: Nasi lemak recipe. Cook rice with coconut milk and pandan leaves. Serve with sambal, cucumber, egg and ikan bilis.

documents.title: Mee goreng recipe
documents.content: Mee goreng recipe. Stir-fry yellow noodles with garlic, egg, bean sprouts and sweet soy sauce. Finish with lime.

documents.title: Kaya toast overview
documents.content: Kaya toast is a familiar Singapore breakfast often served with soft-boiled eggs and kopi. This article describes the dish but gives no ingredient amounts or preparation steps.

documents.title: Z&V Cafe kaya toast recipe
documents.content: Z&V Cafe serves kaya toast, soft-boiled eggs, kopi, nasi lemak and curry puffs. For its kaya toast, toast two slices of bread until crisp. Spread each with one tablespoon of kaya, add two thin slices of cold butter, then sandwich and cut the toast. Serve with eggs and kopi.

documents.title: RC-123 rice cooker instructions
documents.content: RC-123 rice cooker instructions. Rinse the rice, add water to the marked line, close the lid and press Cook. Leave on Keep Warm for 10 minutes before serving.

documents.title: RC-999 rice cooker instructions
documents.content: RC-999 rice cooker instructions. Choose the Quick Rice programme on the touch display, then press Start. This guide is for model RC-999.

documents.title: Peanut-free satay-style sauce
documents.content: Peanut-free satay-style sauce. Blend toasted sunflower seeds, coconut milk, chilli, lemongrass and tamarind. Contains no peanuts. For an allergy, verify every ingredient and avoid cross-contact.

documents.title: Peanut satay sauce
documents.content: Peanut satay sauce. Grind roasted peanuts with chilli, lemongrass, coconut milk and palm sugar. Contains peanuts and is unsuitable for a peanut allergy.

documents.title: Vegetarian chicken rice-style recipe
documents.content: Vegetarian chicken rice-style recipe. Cook rice with ginger, garlic and vegetable stock. Serve with tofu, cucumber and chilli sauce; no chicken is used.

documents.title: White chicken rice method
documents.content: For this Singapore hawker-style dish, simmer a whole chicken with ginger and spring onion for 32 minutes, then cool it quickly. Cook the rice in the chicken poaching broth with garlic and pandan. Serve with cucumber and chilli sauce.

documents.content: Cut aubergine into thick slices and pan-fry until soft. Pound dried chilli with shallots and belacan, fry the paste until fragrant, then toss the cooked aubergine through the sambal.
